description: NaNdWMnO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.85 Å. Nd is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. All Nd-O bond lengths are 2.85 Å. W is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All W-O bond lengths are 1.93 Å. Mn is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Mn-O bond lengths are 2.09 Å. O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Nd, one W, and one Mn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₂Nd₂MnW octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-60°.
